falsification_conditions.condition: BTC-USD closes 18% or more below its close on the verdict date within the next 14 calendar days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 80% match to bottom_2022_may_luna is wrong: that analog is a completed washout base, and an 18%+ slide is continuation, not a holdable bottom, so HOLD/UNKNOWN missed a downside regime.

falsification_conditions.condition: The engine blowoff score prints at or above 70 on any session in the next 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A score of 37 cannot be a post-crash base if euphoria scores 70+; the low-blowoff Luna-bottom template is invalidated and HOLD was the wrong call versus a directional blowoff.

falsification_conditions.condition: On the same session within 14 days, the S&P 500 closes at a new 52-week high and the VIX closes below 14.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Risk has resolved to a confirmed risk-on regime, so UNKNOWN/HOLD is falsified: a long-risk signal was identifiable and the bottom-analog indecision was incorrect.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
